style: Retro-cinematic space battle soundtrack for a pixel-art starship game. Fast driving analog synthesizer arpeggios, a pulsing sequenced bass, punchy live drums and big toms, a tense string ostinato, spacious reverb, a bold clean electric guitar and synth lead melody, felt piano, cello and glass bells. A fight among rusted copper relays above the clouds. Urgent, heroic and melodic, cinematic energy. Purely instrumental. Dm, 110 BPM.
